name: Everlook
summary: Everlook shelters travelers at the meeting of Winterspring’s routes. The Steamwheedle Cartel keeps this northern outpost open to merchants, prospectors, and researchers, offering a neutral refuge from the high-altitude cold.

sections.title: Commerce at the Edge of the World
sections.body: At Winterspring’s crossroads, Everlook is the Steamwheedle Cartel’s northernmost outpost. Like Gadgetzan and Booty Bay, it is a walled settlement beneath permafrost. Alliance and Horde travelers find warmth and shelter here because the town keeps strict neutrality. Its bank and shared auction house are the region’s only operational ones. Hired bruisers guard the settlement, where travelers seek refuge from ferocious frostsabers and yetis.

sections.title: Gears in the Tundra
sections.body:
Everlook’s icy wooden roofs and whimsical penguin wallpaper shelter workshops for engineering and advanced alchemical laboratories. Goblin tinkerers pursue their craft away from prying eyes.

The Argent Dawn recently sent Gregor Greystone to negotiate with town leadership. The order watches the region’s ancient ruins and gathering northern threats with care.

aliases: who is in charge of everlook
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel owns and operates Everlook. The Argent Dawn sent Gregor Greystone as its representative.

faq.q: Why is Everlook safe for both Alliance and Horde?
aliases: can horde and alliance visit everlook
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel enforces strict commercial neutrality. Goblin bruisers quickly pummel anyone who starts a fight, leaving travelers of every allegiance free to trade.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn in Everlook?
aliases: what is argent dawn doing here
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps an official presence in Everlook through its emissary, Gregor Greystone. He represents the order to the goblin merchants and watches for local threats.

faq.q: Where does Everlook get its trade goods?
aliases: where do everlook goods come from
faq.answer: Everlook’s trade goods arrive by trade flights and surface caravans along Winterspring’s main trade routes. Those routes meet at the outpost.

angles.text: Everlook is a major hub for high-level engineers, especially those who specialize in goblin engineering. They can learn to build a dimensional ripper keyed directly to the settlement.
